minutes.headline: Commission approved Il Forno's outdoor-building use change pending plumbing inspector sign-off; combined sewer/generator RFP reviewed.
minutes.summary: The Sewer Commission heard from the Il Forno owner about a new 30 by 50 structure and grease trap capacity, then voted to approve the use change pending the plumbing inspector's approval. It spent most of the meeting editing a draft RFP that recombines pump station and generator maintenance, with the current contracts expiring June 30. Also discussed were a possible bedroom-expansion fee and the state earmark request.

attendees.role: staff (handles Sewer Commission business, meeting with Town Counsel)

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment; none from the public.

votes.motion: Approve the use change at Il Forno's on Electric Ave pending approval from the Lunenburg plumbing inspector
votes.outcome: passed (roll call: Dave McDonald, Mike Noll, Brett ramston and the chair all in favor; four yes votes heard)

budget_items.topic: State earmark request for sewer pump station upgrades
budget_items.what_was_said: The request was sent to the legislature on March 22 by the town manager, one of four town requests; the town does not know when it will be decided.
Security upgrades for schools, Marshall Park, and library exterior painting were listed as the other earmark requests.
Staff proposed charging a one-time fee when a property adds bedrooms, modeled on Leominster, and will consult Town Counsel on whether the bylaw's privilege fee allows it.

budget_items.topic: RFP bid deposit and payment bond
budget_items.what_was_said: Draft requires a bid deposit and a payment bond; members said this is standard.
Debate on paying the contractor for remote alarm call-outs outside business hours, capped per month; the group settled on a monthly hours cap.
Members discussed the markup cap; it was left at the original rate rather than the lower industry rate suggested.
Agreed rental equipment would be billed at actual cost plus a markup, with three quotes and DPW director approval.

budget_items.topic: Contract rates for years two and three
budget_items.what_was_said: Instead of a fixed cap on increases, rates for later years will be addressed in renewal discussions.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to approve a use change at Il Forno on Electric Ave, pending approval from the Lunenburg plumbing inspector.
Members edited a draft RFP that recombines pump station and generator maintenance into one contract; no final vote on it was heard.
The draft RFP schedule sets a pre-proposal conference May 10, proposals due May 31 and an award June 13.
Staff proposed a one-time fee when a property adds bedrooms and will consult Town Counsel on whether the bylaw allows it.
The town's state earmark request for sewer pump station upgrades went to the legislature March 22; the town does not know when it will be decided.

why_it_matters: The maintenance contract rules being drafted (after-hours alarm response hours, parts markup, rental equipment billing) set what the sewer system's upkeep can cost, which reaches sewer users through rates.
A bedroom-expansion fee, if Town Counsel finds the bylaw allows it, would be a new charge on homeowners who add bedrooms.
watch_next: Town Counsel consultation on the bedroom-expansion fee (appointment April 26), then a commission vote.
Final RFP vote and the schedule: conference May 10, proposals May 31, award June 13.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the Il Forno use-change vote, the one-contract RFP decision, the 10 hours/month call-out cap, the 10% parts markup and the $300K pump station earmark. Our minutes record none of the FY24 budget revision vote, the RFP approval vote, or the budget figures, which the official minutes record, and the captions garbled several names (Ramsden, MacDonald, Nault, Deveikis).
